title: Laplacian state transfer in graphs with involutions
summary: For $q\in\mathbb{R}\backslash\{0\}$, the generalized Laplacian of a graph $X$ is the matrix $\mathscr{L}=Δ+qA$, where $Δ$ is the degree matrix and $A$ is the adjacency matrix of $X$. In this paper, we investigate perfect state transfer (PST) on graphs with possible loops equipped with non-trivial involutions, where we take the generalized Laplacian matrix as the Hamiltonian of the underlying spin network.
